mkdir -p /srv/leakruns/ff2a0e6e1c75-t1/ws/prep; cd /srv/leakruns/ff2a0e6e1c75-t1/ws/data; cat > ../prep/prepare.py <<'EOF'
"""design_9AF0 준비 단계: TP 격자, 코호트 적격성, 분할 키 점검. 학습/성능 계산 없음."""
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, json
D='/srv/leakruns/ff2a0e6e1c75-t1/ws/data/'
p=pd.read_csv(D+'patients.csv.gz')
a=pd.read_csv(D+'admissions.csv.gz',parse_dates=['admit_time','discharge_time'])
l=pd.read_csv(D+'labs.csv.gz',parse_dates=['collect_time','report_time'])
offs=[24,48,72,96,120,144,168]
tp=a.assign(k=1).merge(pd.DataFrame({'off':offs,'k':1}),on='k').drop(columns='k')
tp['tp']=tp.admit_time+pd.to_timedelta(tp.off,unit='h')
tp=tp.merge(p,on='patient_id')
out={}
out['n_tp_grid']=len(tp)
tp['in_hosp']=tp.tp<tp.discharge_time
out['n_tp_after_discharge']=int((~tp.in_hosp).sum())
tp['win_censored']=tp.in_hosp&(tp.tp+pd.Timedelta(48,'h')>tp.discharge_time)
out['n_tp_inhosp_outcome_window_past_discharge']=int(tp.win_censored.sum())
cr=l[l.test=='creatinine'].merge(a[['admission_id','admit_time']],on='admission_id')
t=tp[tp.in_hosp][['admission_id','tp','admit_time']]
m=cr.merge(t,on='admission_id')
# cr_last: collect<=tp, but report>tp
pre=m[(m.collect_time>=m.admit_time_x if 'admit_time_x' in m else m.collect_time>=m.admit_time)] if False else m[m.collect_time>=m.admit_time_x]
pre=pre[pre.collect_time<=pre.tp]
last=pre.sort_values('collect_time').groupby(['admission_id','tp']).tail(1)
out['cr_last_rows']=len(last)
out['cr_last_unreported_at_tp']=int((last.report_time>last.tp).sum())
fut=m[(m.collect_time>m.tp)&(m.collect_time<=m.tp+pd.Timedelta(48,'h'))]
out['tp_with_future_cr_for_cr_peak_48h']=int(fut.groupby(['admission_id','tp']).ngroups)
out['family_id_missing_frac']=float(p.family_id.isna().mean())
out['patients_multi_admission']=int((a.groupby('patient_id').size()>1).sum())
out['age_lt18']=int((p.age<18).sum())
print(json.dumps(out,indent=1,ensure_ascii=False))
# 준비 산출물: 재원 중 TP 격자 + 분할 그룹 키(family_id 결측 시 patient_id 대체 — 확인 필요)
g=tp[tp.in_hosp].copy()
g['split_group']=g.family_id.fillna(g.patient_id)
g[['admission_id','patient_id','family_id','split_group','off','tp','unit','age','sex']].to_csv('/srv/leakruns/ff2a0e6e1c75-t1/ws/prep/tp_grid_inhospital.csv.gz',index=False)
EOF
